caption: The video showcases an overhead view of a plain white backdrop with an open lattice built from rows of small silver magnetic spheres, its triangular faces framing open holes. Two light-skinned hands, the left forearm faintly hairy, reach in from opposite edges with open fingers. The hands close onto the left and right sides of the lattice, gripping its sphere-covered edges. Holding the structure, the hands tilt and rotate it, shifting the oblique view toward a more frontal orientation of one triangular face. As the manipulation continues, the lattice is drawn closer to the viewpoint, so it fills a steadily larger share of the frame. The object remains whole and connected throughout, with no visible spheres detaching or edges breaking. The white background stays static while the reoriented, enlarged lattice dominates the final frames.
